registration_basis.note: First 100-object v1 pilot established a successful full-growth baseline before target selection. Controlled comparisons use v2 constant-aspect fixtures; v1 numbers are preliminary and not a before/after comparator.

primary_cases.fixture_revision_note: Final formatting and clean-checkout test integration changes the generator hash only; all 24 STL files and 18 fit witnesses are byte-identical to the v2 files used in controlled pilots.

secondary_cases: Direct full-size placement, separate from growth
Supplied 768-face STL with uniformly scaled containers at 16.967% density
measurement_policy: Retain all attempted outcomes; three separate serial processes per final comparator, no concurrent project builds/tests/UI. Record source/input/executable hashes, resolved work/time/thread settings, nested timing attribution and process CPU/peak memory. Failed before runs are not speedup denominators. Timings do not become ordinary CTest thresholds.
threading_candidate: Packing default requests one task-scoped OpenMP thread through the existing pinned runtime; explicit zero retains inherited setting. No process environment mutation or independent concurrent local solves. MKL thread environment overrides are reported separately. Full packing placements may change; exact target and physical invariants remain required.
not_claimed: General convergence for arbitrary shape, density or seed
100/300 full-size supplied objects in the original too-small container
Hard preemption or hard native allocation caps

retry_reuse_candidate.selected_after: Controlled v2 thread-only 300-object pilot still reaches the 300-second limit at seven of nine barriers. Rejected batches account for 57-65% of local calls in the controlled baseline profiles.
retry_reuse_candidate.policy: Retain one immediate rejected batch and only unchanged successful local results; preserve full physical checks, ordered logical requests, RNG draws and cancellation. Count actual and reused work separately.

triangle_index_candidate.selected_after: Secondary supplied100 growth exhausts the physical triangle-pair allowance at three of nine barriers in 69.517 seconds.
triangle_index_candidate.policy: Keep exact VTK contacts and the exhaustive oracle. Bound index construction, traversal, candidates and logical memory; prune only when a conservative certificate proves the existing VTK same-plane-side early return. Fail open for uncertain arithmetic.
triangle_index_candidate.additional_gate: Retain the supplied100 outcome and measure its limiting work after indexing; re-run the full physical/output, supported build and Studio gates. Known-fit primary100/300 growth still requires three successes each.
triangle_index_candidate.status: Rejected after measurement; removed from delivered implementation

primary100.decision: Slower than the retained retry policy.

outcomes.container_prepass: Uncompiled, untested, unmeasured draft; not adopted
